spec_match.rationale: The page demonstrates its stated contract — CSS precedence over the pathLength presentation attribute — and the previously conflated animatability claim is now substantiated by the new sibling concept path-length-interpolation, cross-linked from this page's see-also.

interactive.rationale: The attribute range, CSS on/off controls, and play/pause control all update their rendered comparison and textual readouts, with a clear pre-150 fallback.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature card's claim that path-length animates with keyframes and transition is now delivered by the dedicated path-length-interpolation concept; this page keeps its cascade-focused scope and links to the interpolation demo.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported-browser fallback is handled cleanly and interpolation endpoints are now covered by the sibling concept, but specificity, inheritance, and invalid-value handling are still not exercised on this page.

references.rationale: The page links directly to ChromeStatus feature 4861677550043136 and the SVG specification pull request.

conformance.rationale: The feature-level conformance suite (v150/support-path-length-as-a-css-property/conformance.json) exists unchanged and its assertions still mirror the page's probes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 driven via Playwright CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this sandbox) exercised the slider (500→1200 readout update), both cascade toggles (effective total 1000↔2000), keyboard Enter activation, and play/pause (animation-play-state paused↔running); desktop and mobile screenshots were captured and read, and the console was clean apart from the environmental fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet failure.

telemetry_health.rationale: The shared telemetry client is injected and loads, but this page still does not emit control-specific cascade or animation assertion events.

design_system.rationale: The page uses shared color variables, pairs button background and foreground overrides, and provides multiple genuine interactive comparisons.

accessibility.rationale: The cascade and play toggles now expose aria-pressed (verified flipping true/false on click and keyboard Enter), the attribute slider's visible label is associated via for/id with the redundant aria-label removed, and the effective-total and playback readouts are role=status live regions whose text now includes the playback state.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3 touch with zero horizontal overflow and all controls reachable, but the pre-existing toggle buttons are ~32px tall, below the ~44px tap-target guideline (left untouched by this smallest-patch a11y fix).

openQuestions.title: Exercise specificity, inheritance, and invalid-value handling
openQuestions.detail: The cascade story covers CSS-beats-attribute, but does not show selector specificity resolving between two path-length declarations, confirm the property is not inherited, or demonstrate that an invalid value (e.g. a negative number) falls back to the attribute. A small extension of the override panel could cover all three.

openQuestions.title: Enlarge toggle tap targets on touch
openQuestions.detail: The .toggle-btn controls compute to roughly 32px height at 360×740; adding min-height to reach ~44px would meet the mobile tap-target guideline without visual redesign.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible toggle button pressed state and announcing dynamic status updates politely
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-pressed to communicate toggle state, explicitly associate visible <label> text with its control via for/id instead of a divergent aria-label, and expose changing results through restrained status live regions without repeating ARIA state in the accessible name.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added aria-pressed to #css-on/#css-off/#anim-btn (kept in sync in renderOverride and the play handler), converted the slider label to <label for="attr-len"> and removed the misleading aria-label="Attr len", and made only #override-readout and #anim-readout role=status (the per-keystroke slider readout deliberately stays non-live to avoid announcement spam).

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider with visible label and live value readout responsive layout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep native range inputs (optionally themed with accent-color) rather than replacing them with custom widgets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The existing native <input type=range> was retained unchanged apart from the label association — smallest-patch rule; no custom slider was introduced.

summary: Regenerated after the goal-setting fix. The two prior open questions are resolved: the corpus-level MAJOR gap (path-length interpolation itself) is now demonstrated by the new sibling concept v150/support-path-length-as-a-css-property/path-length-interpolation/ (linked from this page and the feature index), and the moderate a11y gap is fixed in place with aria-pressed on the three stateful toggles, a for/id-associated slider label, and role=status on the effective-total and playback readouts (which now announce running/paused). Verified in headless Chromium 141 via Playwright CDP at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3: slider, both cascade toggles, keyboard activation, and play/pause all updated DOM state; zero horizontal overflow on mobile; console clean except the environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure. chrome-devtools-mcp was not available in this sandbox, so accessibility evidence is DOM-state-based (aria-pressed/role/for-id assertions plus keyboard activation), not an accessibility-tree dump.
